correctness.rationale: The combinatorial distance formula d(A,B)=min{2(5−|A∩B|),2|A∩B|+1} yields distance classes 0..5 and intersection array {6,5,5,4,4;1,1,2,2,3}. The inclusion filtration gives adjacency eigenvalues (6,−5,4,−3,2,−1) with multiplicities (1,10,44,110,165,132). Independently recomputing the distance-polynomial recurrence gives nonconstant coefficient rows exactly (−5,19,−35,40,−20), (4,10,10,−5,−20), (−3,3,3,−12,8), (2,−2,−7,−2,8), (−1,−5,5,10,−10). Fourth branch derivative positive for all p>=0 by 5^8>2^6·3^7, crosses zero in rational bracket (71/200,89/250), and independently high-precision root≈0.355636232374. The source exact rational-power integer certificate is inspectable and establishes all four competitor branches negative throughout the bracket, a genuinely finite exact sign test rather than sampled values. Fractional-power closure extends negative type downwards; Schoenberg equivalence to all-bandwidth Gaussian PSD and distinct squared-Euclidean point Fourier argument give Gaussian strict PD. At alpha only the multiplicity-165 harmonic vanishes on zero-sum vectors, so centered rank 461−165=296. The independent recurrence and numerical signs corroborate; large-graph BFS/numerical eigen checks in original script were inspected but not replayed separately here.
